# DoubleVerify
> DoubleVerify is a media effectiveness platform that uses AI-driven measurement, verification, and optimization to improve digital advertising outcomes for global brands.

DoubleVerify provides solutions across media quality, fraud prevention, brand suitability, attention measurement, contextual targeting, retail media, CTV, social media, and campaign performance for advertisers, agencies, publishers, and platforms.

## Company
- [Home](https://doubleverify.com/): Overview of DoubleVerify’s media effectiveness platform and core value proposition.
- [About](https://doubleverify.com/about/): Company background, mission, leadership, and corporate information.
- [Careers](https://doubleverify.com/careers/): Open roles, culture, and hiring information across global teams.
- [Contact](https://doubleverify.com/contact/): Contact options for sales, partnerships, support, and general inquiries.
- [Newsroom](https://doubleverify.com/newsroom/): Press releases, company announcements, and media resources.

## Solutions
- [Solutions Overview](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/): Summary of DoubleVerify’s products for media quality, performance, and measurement.
- [Advertisers](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/advertisers/): Solutions tailored for brands seeking safer and more effective media investments.
- [Agencies](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/agencies/): Tools and workflows for agencies managing campaign quality and performance.
- [Publishers](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/publishers/): Products that help publishers improve inventory quality and monetization.
- [Platforms](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/platforms/): Verification and measurement capabilities for media and technology platforms.
- [Retail Media](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/retail-media/): Measurement and optimization solutions for retail media networks and advertisers.

## Media Quality & Protection
- [Brand Safety & Suitability](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/brand-safety-suitability/): Controls and measurement to align ads with brand-appropriate content environments.
- [Fraud & IVT Protection](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/fraud-ivt-protection/): Detection and prevention of invalid traffic and ad fraud across channels.
- [Viewability Measurement](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/viewability/): Measurement of whether ads had the opportunity to be seen.
- [Geo Verification](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/geo-verification/): Confirms impressions are served in intended geographic locations.
- [Authentic Brand Suitability](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/authentic-brand-suitability/): Granular suitability controls using nuanced content classification and avoidance settings.
- [Supply-Side Protection](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/publishers/): Publisher-focused quality controls to protect inventory and revenue.

## Performance & Measurement
- [Attention Measurement](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/attention/): Measures ad exposure and engagement signals linked to campaign effectiveness.
- [Outcome Measurement](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/outcomes/): Connects media quality and exposure metrics to business results.
- [Campaign Performance](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/performance/): Optimization capabilities designed to improve efficiency and media outcomes.
- [Quality Optimization](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/media-quality/): Uses verification data to improve campaign quality and effectiveness.
- [Custom Contextual](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/contextual/): Contextual intelligence for targeting and optimization without relying on identifiers.
- [Measurement Solutions](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/measurement/): Cross-channel measurement products for quality, attention, and effectiveness.

## Channels
- [Connected TV](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/ctv/): Verification and measurement solutions for connected TV advertising environments.
- [Social Media](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/social-media/): Independent measurement and protection across major social platforms.
- [Open Web](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/open-web/): Verification and optimization for display, video, and programmatic web campaigns.
- [Video](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/video/): Media quality and performance measurement for digital video advertising.
- [Mobile App](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/mobile-app/): Fraud, viewability, and brand suitability coverage for in-app advertising.
- [Programmatic](https://doubleverify.com/solutions/programmatic/): Tools supporting programmatic buying quality, transparency, and optimization.
